evidence: Carries the Validation label and restructures validation and block storage entry points including ConnectBlock, AcceptBlock, and ActivateBestChain.
rationale: Eliminates a longstanding hazard where system runtime failures were conflated with block validity in BlockValidationState. As described, non-validating routines like FlushStateToDisk will no longer require a BlockValidationState out-parameter, paving the way for #35570.
